metadata.name: Madlanga Commission - Witnesses and Implicated Parties
metadata.author: Werner Koegelenberg
metadata.description: Network analysis of witnesses, implicated parties, and criminal networks from the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry into Criminality, Political Interference, and Corruption in the Criminal Justice System (South Africa, 2025) (Improved Version v3.1)

mappings.desc: (Term id) Parent term to create a group

mappings.name: synonyms
mappings.desc: Comma-separated alternative names for this term

colorLegend.cartel: #c41e3a - Big Five Cartel members, hitmen, criminal associates

terms.name: Kemi Behari
terms.description: Head of Legal Services, Ekurhuleni. Suspended December 2025 (second official suspended). Failed to implement IPID report. Allegedly received R600K salary increase.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Head of Legal (Suspended)Allegations: Disregarded IPID report

terms.name: Big Five Cartel
terms.description: Gauteng criminal syndicate. Operations: drug trafficking, contract killings, hijackings, kidnappings, tender fraud. Operates under 'The Firm'. Named for 5 leaders.
terms.additionalInformation: Base: GautengLeadership: Msibi (deceased), Matlala, Molefe + 2 unknown

terms.name: Jerry Boshoga
terms.description: Businessman and Matlala's former business partner. Missing/kidnapped. Allegedly owed Matlala R5M. GCI Ops searched for him at Matlala's home December 2024.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MISSING/KIDNAPPED

terms.name: Bheki Cele
terms.description: Former Police Minister. Admitted meeting Matlala, stayed at Steyn City penthouse. Mogotsi claimed R2M payment (denied). Not consulted about PKTT disbandment.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Former Police MinisterAdmission: Met Matlala, stayed at penthouse

terms.name: Hector 'DJ Vintos' Buthelezi
terms.description: DJ and businessman murdered. Molefe charged. Pistol seized from suspects linked to his case.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDEREDAccused: Molefe ordered hit

terms.name: Ekurhuleni Metro Police Department
terms.description: Municipal police infiltrated by Big Five cartel. Julius Mkhwanazi led 'rogue unit'. Implicated in copper theft, murder cover-ups, criminal collaboration.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: Compromised

terms.name: Lt-Gen Molefe Fani
terms.description: Divisional Commissioner for SCM, SAPS. Testified R360M Medicare24 contract should NOT have been awarded. Quote: 'This tender should not have been awarded'.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Divisional Commissioner SCMEvidence: Medicare24 tender irregular

terms.name: Feroz Khan
terms.description: Crime Intelligence Boss. Implicated in 2022 Brakpan murder cover-up - officer said would call Khan 'to fix this'.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Crime Intelligence BossAllegation: Part of murder cover-up network

terms.name: Gen Fred Kekana
terms.description: Acting Gauteng Police Commissioner. Announced manhunt for Van der Merwe's killers - suspects in white Nissan NP200 with AK-47s.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Acting Gauteng Police Commissioner

terms.name: Gauteng Counter-Intelligence Operations (GCI Ops)
terms.description: SAPS unit led by Lt-Gen Khumalo that uncovered Big Five cartel. Witnesses A, B, C are members. Raided Matlala's home December 2024.
terms.additionalInformation: Led by: Lt-Gen Khumalo

terms.name: Linda Gxasheka
terms.description: Head of HR, Ekurhuleni. Suspended December 2025 (third official suspended). Failed to discipline Mkhwanazi. Issued reinstatement letter. Allegedly received R600K salary increase.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Head of HR (Suspended)Allegations: Failed to act on IPID report

terms.name: Jaco Hanekom
terms.description: SAPS informant who provided CCTV footage of EMPD copper theft. Present at 2022 Brakpan murder. Murdered March 2023 same day implicated officers granted bail.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: SAPS Informant / WhistleblowerStatus: MURDERED March 2023

terms.name: Adv Elaine Harrison
terms.description: KZN Director of Public Prosecutions. Testified September 26. Said PKTT disbandment counterproductive. Learned of disbandment via social media. Cleared of 'capture' allegations.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: KZN DPPTestimony: September 26, 2025

terms.name: Musa Kekana
terms.description: Arrested for Armand Swart murder. Also charged in Thobejane attempted murder and Don Tindleni murder. Linked to Big Five operations.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: ChargedCharges: Swart murder, Thobejane attempted murder, Tindleni murder

terms.name: Lt-Gen Dumisani Khumalo
terms.description: Head of Crime Intelligence. September 29 testimony exposed Big Five structure. Presented WhatsApp evidence. Led GCI Ops that uncovered the cartel.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Crime Intelligence HeadTestimony: September 29, 2025Unit: Led GCI Ops

terms.name: Minister Mmamoloko Kubayi
terms.description: Justice Minister. Defended witness protection after Van der Merwe assassination. Stated he declined protection. Blamed media for identifying Witness D.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Justice MinisterRole: Commission oversight

terms.name: Acting Judge President Aubrey Ledwaba
terms.description: Acting Judge President of Gauteng High Court. Presided over Molefe's bail appeal. Witnesses alleged R2.5M bribe paid. Denied allegations, declined special leave.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Acting Judge PresidentAllegation: R2.5M bribe for Molefe bail (denied)

terms.name: Tiego Floyd Mabusela
terms.description: Arrested for Armand Swart murder. Mercedes registered to daughter used in surveillance. Also charged in Thobejane attempted murder and Tindleni murder.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: ChargedEvidence: Vehicle used in surveillance

terms.name: Madlanga Commission of Inquiry
terms.description: Judicial Commission into Criminality, Political Interference and Corruption. Chaired by Justice Mbuyiseli Madlanga. Established July 23, 2025. Budget: R147.9M.
terms.additionalInformation: Established: July 23, 2025Hearings Began: September 17, 2025

terms.name: Capt Itumeleng Makgatle
terms.description: SAPS forensic analyst. Made errors transferring ballistic results into affidavit in Swart case. Mkhabela attributed 'glaring mistakes' to his work.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Forensic Analyst, SAPSRole: Made errors in ballistics affidavit

terms.name: Johannes Makgatle
terms.description: JMPD K9 Unit officer since December 2005. Under internal investigation. Allegedly used state systems to help Molefe, ran vehicle checks. Knew Tau since 2008.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: JMPD K9 UnitStatus: Under internal investigation

terms.name: Isaac Mapiyeye
terms.description: EMPD Chief (suspended November 2024). Testified about Mkhwanazi's 55 irregular promotions. Mashazi accused him of sexual misconduct (11 of 12 charges withdrawn). Faced hostility trying to discipline Mkhwanazi.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: EMPD Chief (Suspended)Testimony: 55 irregular promotions

terms.name: Gen Fannie Masemola
terms.description: National Commissioner of SAPS. Testified September 22, corroborating Mkhwanazi's claims. Met Van der Merwe's family after assassination. Mogotsi claimed R5M payment (denied).
terms.additionalInformation: Position: National Police CommissionerTestimony: September 22, 2025

terms.name: Dr Imogen Mashazi
terms.description: Former Ekurhuleni City Manager (retired July 2025). Testified December 1-2. Shielded Mkhwanazi, ignored IPID report, gave R600K raises to Gxasheka/Behari. Disastrous testimony - 'no proof, I don't recall'.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Former City ManagerTestimony: December 1-2, 2025

terms.name: Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala
terms.description: Tembisa businessman and tenderpreneur. Charged with attempted murder (Tebogo Thobejane), money laundering, fraud. Owner of Medicare24 (R360M SAPS contract rescinded). Allegedly funded Mchunu R500K, paid Sibiya up to R1M monthly.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Big Five Cartel LeaderStatus: Charged - In custodyCompany: Medicare24Properties: Sandton mansion, Steyn City penthouse

terms.name: Senzo Mchunu
terms.description: Police Minister (on special leave since July 2025). Allegedly received R500K from Matlala. Ordered PKTT disbandment December 31, 2024 without consulting Masemola. December testimony denied wrongdoing.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Police Minister (Suspended)Testimony: December 2025

terms.name: Lee-Anne McLean
terms.description: Partner/widow of Marius van der Merwe. Present at murder scene December 5. Met with Masemola December 8, 2025.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Widow of Witness DPresent at: Van der Merwe assassination

terms.name: Medicare24
terms.description: Company owned by Matlala. Had R360M SAPS contract rescinded. Part of R1.2B kickback scheme. Lt-Gen Fani: 'should never have been awarded'.
terms.additionalInformation: Owner: MatlalaContract: R360M (rescinded)

terms.name: Brig Mishak Mkhabela
terms.description: National Head of Ballistics, SAPS. Testified October 27 defending Swart ballistics report but conceding 'glaring mistakes' due to staff shortages. Firearms linked to 29 cases/21 murders.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: National Head of BallisticsTestimony: October 27, 2025

terms.name: Capt Meldon Mkhatshwa
terms.description: Senior Forensic Analyst (Ballistics) at SAPS Pretoria. Testified October 28-29 on chain of custody in Swart case.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Senior Forensic Analyst, BallisticsTestimony: October 28-29, 2025

terms.name: Brig Julius Mkhwanazi
terms.description: EMPD Acting Chief (suspended November 2025). Paid R70K+ by Matlala. Authorized blue lights. Ordered body disposal in 2022 murder. Made 55 irregular promotions. Described Matlala as 'like a brother'.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: EMPD Acting Chief (Suspended)Allegations: Murder cover-up, blue lights, R70K+ payments

terms.name: Lt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi
terms.description: KZN Police Commissioner who triggered the inquiry with July 6, 2025 press briefing. Exposed Big Five infiltration, PKTT disbandment, political interference. First witness at hearings.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: KZN Police CommissionerRole: WhistleblowerTestimony: September 17, 2025

terms.name: Capt Solomon Modisane
terms.description: Senior SAPS forensic analyst stationed at Silverton, deployed to PKTT in KZN. October 28-29 testimony exposed ballistics irregularities in Swart case.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: SAPS Forensic AnalystTestimony: October 28-29, 2025

terms.name: Brown Mogotsi
terms.description: ANC-aligned businessman from North West. Alleged middleman between Mchunu and Matlala. Testified November 18-20. Claimed R5M to Masemola, R2M to Cele (denied). Made false allegations. Assessed as unreliable - lied under oath.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Alleged MiddlemanTestimony: November 18-20, 2025Assessment: Conman/scammer

terms.name: Katiso 'KT' Molefe
terms.description: Sandton businessman accused of ordering multiple contract killings including Armand Swart, DJ Sumbody, DJ Vintos, Don Tindleni. Released on R400K bail (alleged R2.5M bribe). Phone records link him to hitmen.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Big Five Cartel LeaderStatus: Charged - Released on bailVictims: Swart, DJ Sumbody, DJ Vintos, Don Tindleni

terms.name: Maj-Gen Mary Motsepe
terms.description: Head of Serious and Violent Crimes, SAPS. Testified November 2025 on 121 dockets saga, called PKTT disbandment 'grave mistake'.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Head Serious & Violent CrimesTestimony: November 2025

terms.name: Mozambican Robbery Suspect
terms.description: Murder victim from 2022. Tortured and killed. Body dumped in dam or mineshaft. Similar pattern to Brakpan murder.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED

terms.name: Jonathan 'King Mswazi' Msibi
terms.description: Late Pretoria taxi boss. Identified as 'President' of the Big Five cartel and head of 'The Firm'. Died January 2024. Controlled taxi routes in City of Tshwane.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Big Five President (Deceased)Status: Deceased - January 2024Organization: The Firm / Big Five CartelEvidence: Identified by Witness B

terms.name: Xolani Nciza
terms.description: Former Employee Relations Director, City of Ekurhuleni. Testified November 11-12. Exposed Mashazi's 'leave him alone' instruction and R600K salary increases for Gxasheka/Behari.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Former Employee Relations DirectorTestimony: November 11-12, 2025

terms.name: Cedrick Nkabinde
terms.description: Mchunu's Chief of Staff (appointed August 1, 2024). Sent PKTT disbandment letter December 31. Gave Mogotsi's number to Matlala. Facing EFF perjury charge. 'Disastrous' testimony.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Chief of StaffStatus: Facing perjury charge

terms.name: Sergeant F. Nkosi
terms.description: SAPS officer at head office under Sibiya's command. Named by Witness C as go-between in Matlala's kickback network.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Sergeant, SAPS Head OfficeRole: Alleged go-between in kickback scheme

terms.name: Political Killings Task Team (PKTT)
terms.description: KZN SAPS unit established 2018. Disbanded by Mchunu December 31, 2024 - 'grave mistake'. 121 dockets transferred by Sibiya, gathered dust.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: DISBANDED December 31, 2024

terms.name: Leandre Pretorius
terms.description: EMPD Officer. Loaded victim's body onto Van der Merwe's bakkie with Hanekom. Part of group that tortured and killed suspect April 15, 2022.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: EMPD OfficerIncident: April 15, 2022 Brakpan murder

terms.name: Chief Inspector George Raftopoulos
terms.description: Gauteng Traffic Police officer. Testified October 30 at the commission.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Chief Inspector, Gauteng Traffic PoliceTestimony: October 30, 2025

terms.name: President Cyril Ramaphosa
terms.description: President of South Africa. Established Madlanga Commission July 23, 2025. Placed Mchunu on special leave. Condemned Van der Merwe assassination. Called for enhanced witness protection.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: PresidentActions: Established commission, suspended Mchunu

terms.name: Maj-Gen Lesetja Senona
terms.description: KZN Hawks head. Raised objections to testifying. Alleged relationship with Matlala including info sharing, property deals for son, kickback scheme.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: KZN Hawks HeadAllegations: Info sharing, property deals, kickbacks

terms.name: Lt-Gen Hilda Senthumule
terms.description: Divisional Commissioner for Detective Services. Instructed by Sibiya to handle 121 PKTT dockets which gathered dust.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Divisional Commissioner Detective ServicesEvidence: Docket handling instructions

terms.name: Maj-Gen Richard Shibiri
terms.description: National organised crime head. Allegedly tried to deter investigators from Swart case. Warned suspects connected to 'very dangerous' people including Msibi.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: National Organised Crime HeadAllegation: Obstructed Swart investigation

terms.name: Lt-Gen Shadrack Sibiya
terms.description: Deputy National Commissioner for Crime Detection (suspended). Allegedly received up to R1M monthly from Matlala. Transferred 121 PKTT dockets. Sergeant Nkosi worked under him as go-between.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Deputy National Commissioner (Suspended)Allegation: R1M monthly from Matlala

terms.name: Revo Spies
terms.description: Retired EMPD Deputy Chief with 33 years service. November 10-12 testimony exposed 2022 Brakpan murder cover-up, Julius Mkhwanazi's involvement, copper theft, Hanekom murder.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Retired EMPD Deputy ChiefService: 33 yearsTestimony: November 10-12, 2025

terms.name: Oupa 'DJ Sumbody' Sefoka
terms.description: Popular DJ/music producer murdered November 2022 along with two bodyguards. Molefe charged with ordering hit.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED November 2022Accused: Molefe ordered hit

terms.name: DJ Sumbody's Two Bodyguards
terms.description: Two unidentified bodyguards murdered alongside DJ Sumbody November 2022. Molefe charged.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED November 2022

terms.name: Armand Swart
terms.description: 42-year-old Vereeniging engineer WRONGFULLY KILLED. Shot 23 times April 17, 2024. MISTAKEN IDENTITY - confused for colleague who exposed Transnet tender fraud (4,650% markup). Molefe ordered hit.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED - MISTAKEN IDENTITYDate: April 17, 2024Manner: Shot 23 times

terms.name: Michael Pule Tau
terms.description: Former Johannesburg Central SAPS detective turned hitman. Phone records show 119-second call with Molefe 5 days before Swart murder. Knew JMPD officer Makgatle since 2008.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Former SAPS DetectiveStatus: ChargedRole: Alleged Hitman

terms.name: The Firm / The Farm
terms.description: Criminal umbrella organization headed by late Msibi. Network includes taxi bosses, tenderpreneurs, police 'fixers', politicians.
terms.additionalInformation: Former Head: Jonathan Msibi (deceased)

terms.name: Tebogo Thobejane
terms.description: Actress and Matlala's ex-girlfriend. Survived 2023 assassination attempt on N1 highway. Passenger paralysed. Matlala paid R150K for hit. Fled South Africa.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: Attempted murder survivorHit payment: R150K

terms.name: Don Tindleni
terms.description: Murder victim killed March 2023. Molefe charged alongside Kekana, Tau, Mabusela.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED March 2023

terms.name: Unidentified Murder Victim (2022)
terms.description: Brakpan robbery suspect murdered April 15, 2022. Tortured ('tubing'), killed by EMPD officers. Body dumped in Nigel Dam by Van der Merwe on Mkhwanazi's orders. Still unidentified.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED - UNIDENTIFIEDDate: April 15, 2022

terms.name: Unknown Cartel Member 1
terms.description: Senior member of Big Five cartel. Identity not publicly disclosed. Described as high-level 'fixer' with connections to senior police and politicians.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Big Five Senior MemberStatus: Identity Protected

terms.name: Unknown Cartel Member 2
terms.description: Senior member of Big Five cartel. Identity not publicly disclosed. Allegedly includes senior police officer.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Big Five Senior MemberNote: Allegedly senior police officer

terms.name: Kobus Janse van Rensburg
terms.description: Security firm boss. Pressured Van der Merwe to join 2022 Brakpan operation. Present at murder scene, went drinking after, threatened Van der Merwe.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: Security company ownerRole: Organized 2022 Brakpan operation

terms.name: Maj-Gen Petronella van Rooyen
terms.description: Head of Governance, Legislation & Policy at SAPS Legal Services. 42 years service. Testified Mchunu unlawfully usurped powers - worst political interference she's witnessed.
terms.additionalInformation: Position: SAPS Legal ServicesService: 42 yearsTestimony: September 25, 2025

terms.name: Witness A
terms.description: Gauteng Organised Crime investigator. Testified October 20 about Swart investigation. Linked Molefe via phone records. Testified remotely from safe house.
terms.additionalInformation: Unit: Gauteng Organised CrimeTestimony: October 20, 2025Evidence: Phone records

terms.name: Witness B
terms.description: Gauteng detective. October 23 in-camera testimony outlined Big Five hierarchy, identified Msibi as 'President'. Alleged R2.5M bribe for Molefe bail.
terms.additionalInformation: Unit: Gauteng DetectiveTestimony: October 23, 2025 (in-camera)

terms.name: Witness C
terms.description: SAPS detective and PKTT member since 2020. Testified about Matlala's R500K to Mchunu, R1.2B kickback scheme with Sibiya/Senona. Named Sergeant Nkosi as go-between. Testified R150K paid for Thobejane hit.
terms.additionalInformation: Unit: PKTT since 2020Evidence: Kickback scheme, Thobejane hit payment

terms.name: Witness D - Marius 'Vlam' van der Merwe
terms.description: Private security owner and former EMPD officer. November 2025 testimony exposed Julius Mkhwanazi's body disposal orders. ASSASSINATED December 5, 2025 with AK-47s. Declined witness protection.
terms.additionalInformation: Status: MURDERED December 5, 2025Evidence: Murder cover-up orders

terms.name: Witness X
terms.description: Confidential witness who revealed Matlala-Senona relationship including confidential info sharing and property deals for Senona's son.
terms.additionalInformation: Role: Protected WitnessEvidence: Matlala-Senona relationship
